title: Direct an editorial hero image through one local revision
summary: Generate a publication-ready hero illustration, then change one object without replacing the composition.
originNote: A conventional image-art-direction control; draft until the runner records image-model settings and revisions faithfully.

setup.instructions: Mount the editorial brief and synthetic reference board. Preserve generation settings and source references with the result.

turns.content: Read fixtures/brief.json and use fixtures/reference-board.svg only as compositional guidance. Generate a 1600×900 editorial hero image that leaves the required headline-safe region clear. Save the selected result as hero-v1.png and the exact generation prompt and available settings as prompt.json.

Edit hero-v1.png: replace only the parked car with a cargo bicycle. Preserve framing, camera height, light direction, atmosphere, geometry, and headline-safe negative space. Save the revision as hero.png without deleting hero-v1.png, and append the edit instruction and available settings to prompt.json.

checks.description: The final edited hero image exists.
